chapter_title_en: The Butcher of the Demon Mountain
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 192: Ji Ning & Northson Raid a Demon's Lair - Butcher of the Mountain
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning and Mu Northson launch a surgical strike on a Wanxiang great demon's lair. A brutal duel, a fox-wife crushed to paste, and two more demon lords inbound for a 3v2 brawl!
og_title: They Brought a Child to Eat... So They Got Butchered
og_description: Ji Ning walks into a demon's lair and finds a human child kept as livestock. What follows is a swift, merciless lesson in Xianxia justice. Plus: two more Wanxiang great demons arrive!
twitter_title: Desolate Era 192: When Demons Hunt Humans, the Sword Comes Calling
twitter_description: A demon kept a human child for dinner. Mu Northson and Ji Ning took that personally. Wanxiang vs. Wanxiang action with a side of moral fury.
